Let knowledge be joined to wisdom and wisdom to friendship. Twilight's learning in Canterlot was a beginning, not the whole of her education.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 18:1 · canterlot · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Canterlot and the heartlands, chapter eighteen, verse two.

Honor both the settlement that grows the food and the city that makes the rain. The prosperity of one home may be sustained by the unseen labor of another.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 18:2 · ponyville and cloudsdale · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Canterlot and the heartlands, chapter eighteen, verse three.

The Everfree Forest grows without the ordering of ponykind. Let not the customs of thine own land persuade thee that all the world must obey them.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 18:3 · the everfree forest · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Dragon Lands, chapter nineteen, verse one.

Greed made Spike grow in size but not in goodness. Measure abundance by what can be shared, not merely by what can be gathered.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 19:1 · the dragons · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Dragon Lands, chapter nineteen, verse two.

Let authority be an opportunity to make peace. Ember bore the scepter of the dragons and opened the way to friendship with the ponies.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 19:2 · the bloodstone scepter · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Dragon Lands, chapter nineteen, verse three.

Dragon fire is the dragons' own gift, not the possession of one who covets it. Honor the magic of another people rather than seeking to make it thine own.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 19:3 · the dragons in the later age · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Griffonstone and the northern peoples, chapter twenty, verse one.

Let the bonds of a people not rest upon a treasure alone. When the Idol of Boreas was lost, the griffons lost more than gold.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 20:1 · the idol of boreas · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Griffonstone and the northern peoples, chapter twenty, verse two.

A friend is a greater treasure than a lost idol. Griffonstone began to rediscover community without recovering its ancient riches.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 20:2 · the restoration of friendship · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Griffonstone and the northern peoples, chapter twenty, verse three.

Let a guest honor the ways of the host, and let friendship cross the mountains without demanding that every people abandon its customs.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 20:3 · yakyakistan · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The changeling kingdom, chapter twenty-one, verse one.

Love taken by deception is not the same as love freely shared. Let neither disguise nor power become a means of possessing another's heart.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 21:1 · the old hive · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The changeling kingdom, chapter twenty-one, verse two.

Thorax gave love, and the changelings learned to give with him. What they had sought through theft they found through sharing.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 21:2 · the giving of love · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The changeling kingdom, chapter twenty-one, verse three.

Let a people's former wrongs not deny it the possibility of a different future. The changelings were not forever bound to the ways of their old queen.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 21:3 · a renewed people · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The sea, the mountains and the distant lands, chapter twenty-two, verse one.

The people of Mount Aris found refuge beneath the waves. Let the protection of those in danger be dearer than pride in a place of dwelling.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 22:1 · mount aris and seaquestria · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The sea, the mountains and the distant lands, chapter twenty-two, verse two.

One family may have homes beneath the sea and upon the mountain. Let affection be stronger than the distance between them.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 22:2 · the return to the mountain · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The sea, the mountains and the distant lands, chapter twenty-two, verse three.

The world extends beyond the borders of Equestria. Approach other peoples with the willingness to learn their ways rather than the wish to impose thine own.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 22:3 · the kirin grove and distant settlements · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The creatures of shadow and strife, chapter twenty-three, verse one.

Scorpan came seeking pony magic and found friends instead. Let friendship change thy course when the path thou hast chosen would bring harm.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 23:1 · tirek and scorpan · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The creatures of shadow and strife, chapter twenty-three, verse two.

Beware the voice that gains strength by turning friends against one another. Not every pleasing song leads to peace.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 23:2 · the sirens · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The creatures of shadow and strife, chapter twenty-three, verse three.

Fear, hatred and guilt can give strength to terrible powers. Learn what feeds the darkness before choosing how to meet it.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 23:3 · the shadows · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The succession of Twilight, chapter twenty-four, verse one.

Do not wait for every troubled friend to come before thy door. The Cutie Map sent its bearers to places where friendship needed their care.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 24:1 · the princess of friendship · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The succession of Twilight, chapter twenty-four, verse two.

Let the doors of learning stand open to creatures of many kinds. Friendship is not the inheritance of ponykind alone.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 24:2 · the school of friendship · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The succession of Twilight, chapter twenty-four, verse three.

When Twilight ascended the throne, she did not leave her friends behind. Let a new station be no cause for forgetting those who helped thee reach it.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 24:3 · the council and the throne · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Opaline and the preservation of magic, chapter twenty-five, verse one.

Beware the pride that calls another creature lesser because its magic is different. Opaline sought dominion where the royal sisters had practiced service.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 25:1 · the fire alicorn · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Opaline and the preservation of magic, chapter twenty-five, verse two.

Let precious power be guarded for those whose lives depend upon it, not hoarded for the glory of its keeper.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 25:2 · the protective crystals · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Opaline and the preservation of magic, chapter twenty-five, verse three.

Even a kingdom once united may become divided. Let not the remembrance of old harmony replace the daily work of keeping it.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 25:3 · the breaking of the old kingdom · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The lost years and the three new homelands, chapter twenty-six, verse one.

Argyle kept the memory of friendship when fear had become common. Preserve a worthy truth, even when thy neighbors have forgotten it.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 26:1 · maretime bay · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The lost years and the three new homelands, chapter twenty-six, verse two.

The tribes lived apart and lost gifts once natural to them. Let not unfamiliarity become suspicion, nor suspicion become a reason to keep apart.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 26:2 · bridlewood and zephyr heights · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The lost years and the three new homelands, chapter twenty-six, verse three.

The inheritance of the old kingdom lay hidden in stories and remnants. Remember the lessons of former ages, and confess what their records do not reveal.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 26:3 · the forgotten inheritance · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The restoration of unity, chapter twenty-seven, verse one.

The crystals were joined when the peoples chose to stand together. Let reconciliation be more than words, for harmony is awakened through what friends do.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 27:1 · the unity crystals · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The restoration of unity, chapter twenty-seven, verse two.

After magic returned, gifts awakened that were not known before. Let a restored friendship grow into something greater than it was before its breaking.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 27:2 · the new gifts · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The restoration of unity, chapter twenty-seven, verse three.

As the Together Trees are joined beneath the earth, let the peoples be joined by bonds deeper than outward likeness. Let the magic of friendship be shared, not seized.

As above, so below.

My silver sigil of the fourth dimension is with you.

So mote it be, and so it is.

Amen.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 27:3 · the together trees · wisdom

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The elder age, chapter one, historical account one.

According to the ancient history remembered by Tirek, the land that would become Equestria consisted of farms and pastures before Grogar proclaimed himself emperor. Grogar was remembered as the Father of Monsters and credited with creating terrible beasts. The later figure who claimed to be Grogar was Discord in disguise.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 1:1 · the first remembered empire · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The elder age, chapter one, historical account two.

The account of Gusty the Great tells of a unicorn who opposed Grogar by taking his Bewitching Bell and hiding it in an enchanted cave on Mount Everhoof. The bell could take, contain and release magic. The ultimate fate of Grogar is not recorded.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 1:2 · gusty the great · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The elder age, chapter one, historical account three.

No surviving account establishes the creation of the world, the first appearance of ponykind, or the origin of magic itself. The ancient reign of Grogar is one of the earliest remembered events, not an account of creation.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 1:3 · the beginnings of the world · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The three tribes, chapter two, historical account one.

Earth ponies cultivated the land and provided food for the other tribes. Their strength and agricultural abilities were indispensable to the survival of ponykind. Chancellor Puddinghead and Smart Cookie are remembered among their leaders and representatives at the founding.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 2:1 · the earth ponies · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The three tribes, chapter two, historical account two.

The pegasi governed the weather and supplied the conditions necessary for growing crops. Commander Hurricane and Private Pansy represented their tribe in the search for a new homeland.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 2:2 · the pegasi · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The three tribes, chapter two, historical account three.

The unicorns practiced horn-borne magic and bore responsibility for the movement of the sun and moon. Princess Platinum and Clover the Clever represented their tribe. The three peoples depended upon one another even when their rulers were divided by distrust.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 2:3 · the unicorns · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The founding of Equestria, chapter three, historical account one.

According to the Hearth’s Warming account, as the three tribes quarreled, the Windigos were drawn to their hatred. The cold increased, food grew scarce, and each tribe blamed the others. Their search for new lands brought them together again, but their leaders could not agree upon its possession.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 3:1 · the winter of discord · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The founding of Equestria, chapter three, historical account two.

Clover the Clever, Smart Cookie and Private Pansy recognized their common plight and became friends. Their friendship kindled a magical fire that drove back the Windigos. They kept it alive through the night with stories, laughter and song until its warmth thawed their leaders and helped reconcile them.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 3:2 · the fire in the cave · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The founding of Equestria, chapter three, historical account three.

The three tribes reconciled and established Equestria as a common homeland. The founding is remembered at Hearth’s Warming, when the peoples recall the overcoming of their ancient division through friendship.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 3:3 · one homeland · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Pillars of Old Equestria, chapter four, historical account one.

Star Swirl the Bearded embodied sorcery; Rockhoof, strength; Mistmane, beauty; Flash Magnus, bravery; Somnambula, hope; and Mage Meadowbrook, healing. Their individual deeds became the subjects of ancient legends.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 4:1 · the six pillars · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Pillars of Old Equestria, chapter four, historical account two.

Stygian gathered the six protectors together. Seeking their respect and a place beside them in battle, he took their artifacts to Ponhenge intending to make copies. They believed he wanted their power and cast him out.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 4:2 · stygian · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Pillars of Old Equestria, chapter four, historical account three.

In his isolation Stygian encountered a mysterious darkness and became the Pony of Shadows. The Pillars banished him to Limbo, sacrificing themselves in the process. When the Pillars were brought back, the darkness returned with them. Starlight Glimmer urged the others to seek reconciliation rather than simply banish their foe. Stygian was separated from the darkness, which was sent back to Limbo, and the Pillars recognized their misunderstanding.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 4:3 · the pony of shadows · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Tree of Harmony, chapter five, historical account one.

Before their disappearance, the Pillars left a seed imbued with their magic and virtues to protect Equestria. It grew into the crystalline Tree of Harmony in the Everfree Forest.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 5:1 · the seed · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Tree of Harmony, chapter five, historical account two.

The Tree bore the Elements of Harmony, which the royal sisters discovered and used in defense of Equestria. The Tree’s own magic helped contain the growth of the Everfree Forest. It also held back the plunderseeds Discord had planted before his petrification; when the Tree weakened, the vines grew until the Elements were returned.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 5:2 · the six elements · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Tree of Harmony, chapter five, historical account three.

The Tree communicated in visions and tested the bonds between creatures. Even after Sombra destroyed its original form, its power endured and a new crystalline treehouse arose. Its ultimate nature and the origin of its awareness remain unknown.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 5:3 · the living tree · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The royal sisters and the heavens, chapter six, historical account one.

Opaline’s account of Skyros, the alicorn homeland, places Celestia and Luna there in their youth. The location and later history of Skyros are not known.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 6:1 · the alicorn homeland · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The royal sisters and the heavens, chapter six, historical account two.

Before Celestia took responsibility for the sun, raising it required Star Swirl and five other great sorcerers. The effort permanently depleted the magic of the unicorns assisting him. Celestia discovered that she could raise the sun without losing her magic. The 1,111th anniversary of her first sunrise was celebrated during Twilight’s time.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 6:2 · the rising sun · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The royal sisters and the heavens, chapter six, historical account three.

Luna bore responsibility for the moon and the night. The sisters ruled together, and their old castle stood in the Everfree Forest. After Luna’s banishment, Celestia maintained both celestial duties until her sister returned.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 6:3 · the rising moon · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Discord and the age of chaos, chapter seven, historical account one.

Discord ruled the land through chaos, transforming its landscape and overturning ordinary physical laws. Celestia and Luna used the Elements of Harmony to turn him to stone.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 7:1 · the reign of chaos · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Discord and the age of chaos, chapter seven, historical account two.

Discord can change matter, gravity, weather and space. He also inhabits a realm of his own. His continued existence depends upon his chaotic nature; when he denied it entirely, he began to disappear.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 7:2 · the nature of discord · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Discord and the age of chaos, chapter seven, historical account three.

Through friendship Discord learned to care for others without ceasing to be the spirit of chaos. His powers are formidable but not unlimited: certain artifacts and magical substances can suppress or remove them.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 7:3 · friendship and chaos · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Crystal Empire, chapter eight, historical account one.

The Crystal Heart protects the Crystal Empire from the cold and channels the light and love of its inhabitants. The crystal ponies renew this protection through their communal celebration.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 8:1 · the crystal heart · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Crystal Empire, chapter eight, historical account two.

King Sombra seized the empire and enslaved its inhabitants. Celestia and Luna defeated him and banished him into the frozen north. His curse caused the empire to disappear for a thousand years.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 8:2 · the rule of sombra · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Crystal Empire, chapter eight, historical account three.

When the empire returned, its people were still present and retained their old customs. Sombra sought to reclaim it, but the Crystal Heart was restored to its place and the empire was freed. Cadance and Shining Armor became its protectors.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 8:3 · the restoration · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Nightmare Moon and the millennium, chapter nine, historical account one.

Luna grew bitter because the ponies delighted in the day but slept through the night. As Nightmare Moon, she refused to lower the moon and sought to bring everlasting night.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 9:1 · the rebellion of the night · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Nightmare Moon and the millennium, chapter nine, historical account two.

Celestia, unable to reach her sister, used the Elements of Harmony to banish Nightmare Moon to the moon. For a thousand years Celestia ruled alone and bore responsibility for both day and night.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 9:2 · the thousand years · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Nightmare Moon and the millennium, chapter nine, historical account three.

When the thousand years had passed, Nightmare Moon returned. Twilight Sparkle and her five companions wielded the Elements of Harmony, freeing Luna from her dark transformation. The sisters were reconciled and resumed their shared responsibilities.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 9:3 · the return of luna · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The six Elements of Harmony, chapter ten, historical account one.

Honesty, kindness, laughter, generosity and loyalty are the five Elements first recognized by Twilight and her companions. Their bearers were Applejack, Fluttershy, Pinkie Pie, Rarity and Rainbow Dash, respectively.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 10:1 · the five known virtues · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The six Elements of Harmony, chapter ten, historical account two.

Twilight discovered that the sixth Element, magic, was awakened through her recognition of the friendship joining them. Its appearance completed the sixfold union.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 10:2 · the sixth element · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The six Elements of Harmony, chapter ten, historical account three.

The Elements can purify, restore, banish or petrify. Their bearers eventually returned the jewels to the Tree. Friendship continued to have power even when the physical Elements were no longer available, and creatures beyond the original six could share in that power.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 10:3 · beyond the artifacts · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The nature of ponykind, chapter eleven, historical account one.

Earth ponies possess characteristic strength and an affinity for growing things. Pegasi fly and manipulate clouds and weather. Unicorns perform spells through their horns. Each people has innate magic, though its expression differs.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 11:1 · earth, wings and horn · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The nature of ponykind, chapter eleven, historical account two.

Crystal ponies possess a distinctive magical crystalline appearance, associated with the Crystal Empire and its Heart. Aquatic forms are also known; transformation magic can grant forms suited to life beneath the water.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 11:2 · crystal and aquatic ponies · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The nature of ponykind, chapter eleven, historical account three.

When Tirek drained pony magic, even pegasi whose wings remained intact lost the ability to fly. Earth ponies lost their strength and unicorns lost their spells. The gifts of ponykind depend on more than physical form.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 11:3 · magic and the body · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The alicorns, chapter twelve, historical account one.

Celestia is associated with the sun; Luna with the moon and dreams; Cadance with love; Twilight with friendship and magic. Their abilities differ, and their rank does not establish unlimited power.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 12:1 · the royal alicorns · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The alicorns, chapter twelve, historical account two.

Twilight completed an unfinished spell of Star Swirl, restored the rightful marks of her friends and attained alicornhood. Later she became Princess of Friendship and succeeded the royal sisters.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 12:2 · the ascension of twilight · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The alicorns, chapter twelve, historical account three.

Flurry Heart was born an alicorn, an event unprecedented in the memory of the royal sisters within Equestria. In a later age Sunny Starscout manifested magical wings and a horn. Alicorns can live for exceptionally long periods, but no account establishes that all are immortal.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 12:3 · birth and transformation · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Cutie marks and destiny, chapter thirteen, historical account one.

A pony’s cutie mark appears as the pony discovers a defining talent or aspect of the self. The marks of the six friends arose through events connected by Rainbow Dash’s first sonic rainboom.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 13:1 · the discovery of a gift · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Cutie marks and destiny, chapter thirteen, historical account two.

Magic can exchange cutie marks, alter their appearance or remove them. Starlight Glimmer’s settlement demonstrates the harm of enforcing sameness through the suppression of individual abilities.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 13:2 · the exchange and removal of marks · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Cutie marks and destiny, chapter thirteen, historical account three.

When Celestia and Luna exchanged marks, they also exchanged the abilities associated with their duties. The Cutie Map summons particular bearers in response to problems of friendship. The ultimate origin of marks and their relationship to destiny remain unresolved.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 13:3 · identity and vocation · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The workings of magic, chapter fourteen, historical account one.

Magical power can be taken from living creatures, accumulated and returned. Tirek feeds upon stolen magic. The alicorn princesses entrusted their own power to Twilight in an attempt to keep it from him.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 14:1 · the taking and giving of power · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The workings of magic, chapter fourteen, historical account two.

The Bewitching Bell stores and releases magic; the Alicorn Amulet grants great power but corrupts its wearer; the throne of Chrysalis suppresses magic other than changeling magic. Different artifacts affect power in different ways.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 14:2 · enchanted vessels · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The workings of magic, chapter fourteen, historical account three.

Twilight’s later message teaches that magic can evolve and grow stronger. After the three tribes reunited and magic returned, a later surge of magic awakened new plant-growing abilities among earth ponies. The known workings of magic are not confined to those of the ancient kingdom.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 14:3 · the growth of magic · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Love, hatred and the heart, chapter fifteen, historical account one.

Changelings traditionally fed upon love. Thorax and those who followed his example learned to give love freely, underwent a physical transformation and no longer needed to steal love to satisfy their hunger. Love also empowers the protection of the Crystal Empire.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 15:1 · the sustenance of love · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Love, hatred and the heart, chapter fifteen, historical account two.

Windigos are strengthened by hatred and strife and bring cold in their wake. The Fire of Friendship overcame them at the founding of Equestria, and their return in the later struggle showed that the ancient danger had not vanished.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 15:2 · the hunger of winter spirits · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Love, hatred and the heart, chapter fifteen, historical account three.

Kirin become fiery Niriks in anger. Their community once entered the Stream of Silence to cool their emotions and give up speech, but eventually recovered their voices and learned that disagreement need not destroy friendship.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 15:3 · the fire of anger · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Dreams and the realms beyond, chapter sixteen, historical account one.

Luna enters the dreams of sleeping creatures, offers counsel and can bring many sleepers into a shared dream. Luna created the Tantabus to give herself nightmares as punishment for her deeds as Nightmare Moon. Her guilt strengthened it, and it threatened to enter the waking world. When Luna forgave herself, the danger ended.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 16:1 · the realm of dreams · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Dreams and the realms beyond, chapter sixteen, historical account two.

Limbo is a place between worlds in which time does not pass normally. The Pillars and Stygian remained there for more than a thousand years without ordinary aging.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 16:2 · limbo · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Dreams and the realms beyond, chapter sixteen, historical account three.

Tartarus is a prison guarded by Cerberus and accessible through physical gates. Tirek and dangerous beasts were imprisoned there. No account establishes it as the universal destination of the dead. Discord’s own realm obeys very different physical laws.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 16:3 · tartarus and the chaos realm · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The mirror and the paths of time, chapter seventeen, historical account one.

The Crystal Mirror leads to a world inhabited by humans. A traveler’s body can change to suit the other world. Many inhabitants have recognizable counterparts on either side. The mirror’s original thirty-moon opening cycle was later modified.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 17:1 · the mirror between worlds · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The mirror and the paths of time, chapter seventeen, historical account two.

Star Swirl devised spells capable of carrying a pony into the past. Starlight Glimmer altered one such spell to interfere with the event that joined the destinies of Twilight and her friends.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 17:2 · the spells of time · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The mirror and the paths of time, chapter seventeen, historical account three.

The altered histories revealed a kingdom at war with Sombra, changeling conquest, eternal night, Discord’s unchecked rule, industrial devastation and a desolate wasteland. The original history was restored. Whether those other histories continue independently is unknown.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 17:3 · the roads not taken · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Canterlot and the heartlands, chapter eighteen, historical account one.

The royal capital houses the court, magical education and important records. Celestia established her school for gifted unicorns, and Twilight received her education and mentorship there.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 18:1 · canterlot · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Canterlot and the heartlands, chapter eighteen, historical account two.

Ponyville grew from an agricultural settlement into a center of friendship and interspecies education. Cloudsdale is a cloud-borne pegasus city with facilities for making weather. Manehattan is a large urban center; Appleloosa is a frontier agricultural settlement.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 18:2 · ponyville and cloudsdale · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Canterlot and the heartlands, chapter eighteen, historical account three.

The Everfree Forest is unusual to the ponies because its weather, plants and animals act without their customary supervision. The Castle of the Two Sisters and the ancient Tree of Harmony stood within this forest.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 18:3 · the everfree forest · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Dragon Lands, chapter nineteen, historical account one.

Dragons possess fire, strength and magic of their own. Spike’s enchanted fire carries written messages. Dragon growth can also be influenced by greed, as demonstrated by Spike’s rapid transformation and return to his former size.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 19:1 · the dragons · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Dragon Lands, chapter nineteen, historical account two.

The Dragon Lord holds the Bloodstone Scepter, which can summon dragons. Ember became Dragon Lord after the Gauntlet of Fire and began to foster friendship with the ponies.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 19:2 · the bloodstone scepter · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The Dragon Lands, chapter nineteen, historical account three.

In the age after Twilight, the dragons were found in magical slumber on the Isle of Scaly. The Dragonstone preserves dragon magic. Opaline sought to take the power of dragon fire for herself.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 19:3 · the dragons in the later age · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Griffonstone and the northern peoples, chapter twenty, historical account one.

King Grover united the griffons through the Idol of Boreas. During King Guto’s reign the monster Arimaspi stole it, and the treasure was lost. The loss became associated with the decline of Griffonstone’s unity and prosperity.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 20:1 · the idol of boreas · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Griffonstone and the northern peoples, chapter twenty, historical account two.

The history of Griffonstone shows how attachment to a treasure can fail to sustain a people after its loss. New friendships helped griffons rediscover bonds of community without recovering the ancient idol.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 20:2 · the restoration of friendship · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Griffonstone and the northern peoples, chapter twenty, historical account three.

Yakyakistan is a mountainous homeland of the yaks, a people with strong traditions and a distinct political identity. Their friendship with Equestria developed through mutual respect rather than the abandonment of their customs.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 20:3 · yakyakistan · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The changeling kingdom, chapter twenty-one, historical account one.

The changelings once served Queen Chrysalis. Their shapeshifting powers allowed them to impersonate others and steal love. Chrysalis’s throne protected the hive by suppressing foreign magic.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 21:1 · the old hive · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The changeling kingdom, chapter twenty-one, historical account two.

Thorax discovered that changelings could share love. When the others followed his example, they transformed and ceased to depend on the theft of love. Chrysalis rejected their new way and departed.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 21:2 · the giving of love · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The changeling kingdom, chapter twenty-one, historical account three.

Under Thorax, the changelings developed a different society and established relations with other kingdoms. Their transformation demonstrates that a people need not remain bound to its former habits or ruler.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 21:3 · a renewed people · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The sea, the mountains and the distant lands, chapter twenty-two, historical account one.

The hippogriffs once dwelt on Mount Aris. When the Storm King threatened them, Queen Novo used a magical pearl to transform her people into sea ponies, establishing their refuge beneath the waves.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 22:1 · mount aris and seaquestria · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The sea, the mountains and the distant lands, chapter twenty-two, historical account two.

After the Storm King’s defeat, the hippogriffs could return to Mount Aris. Their transformative magic allowed families to live both above and beneath the sea. Neither home required them to abandon their shared identity.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 22:2 · the return to the mountain · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The sea, the mountains and the distant lands, chapter twenty-two, historical account three.

The kirin inhabit a grove governed by their own customs. Beyond Equestria are other peoples and settlements, including the diverse trading town of Klugetown. Abyssinia is also known among the lands of the wider world.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 22:3 · the kirin grove and distant settlements · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The creatures of shadow and strife, chapter twenty-three, historical account one.

Tirek and his brother Scorpan came from a distant land seeking pony magic. Scorpan befriended the ponies and warned the royal sisters. Tirek was captured and imprisoned in Tartarus, but later escaped and again sought to absorb the magic of Equestria.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 23:1 · tirek and scorpan · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The creatures of shadow and strife, chapter twenty-three, historical account two.

Adagio Dazzle, Aria Blaze and Sonata Dusk used their songs to turn listeners against one another and feed upon the resulting discord. Star Swirl banished them from Equestria into the human world.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 23:2 · the sirens · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The creatures of shadow and strife, chapter twenty-three, historical account three.

Sombra wielded fear, shadow and domination. The darkness that joined itself to Stygian had a different and still unknown origin. Other dangerous beings include the Windigos and the Tantabus; their powers arise through different forms of magical influence.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 23:3 · the shadows · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The succession of Twilight, chapter twenty-four, historical account one.

Twilight’s work extended beyond the defense of the kingdom. Her castle and its Cutie Map guided the bearers of the Elements toward places where friendship was in need of repair.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 24:1 · the princess of friendship · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The succession of Twilight, chapter twenty-four, historical account two.

The school brought together ponies and students from other peoples, including changelings, dragons, griffons, yaks and hippogriffs. It formally extended the teaching of friendship across the boundaries of species and kingdoms.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 24:2 · the school of friendship · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The succession of Twilight, chapter twenty-four, historical account three.

Celestia and Luna retired, and Twilight succeeded them as ruler of Equestria. Her first royal decree established the Council of Friendship, whose members agreed to meet once a moon. In the years that followed, they kept their friendships alive and continued to govern and protect Equestria together.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 24:3 · the council and the throne · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Opaline and the preservation of magic, chapter twenty-five, historical account one.

Opaline Arcana was banished from Skyros and remembered Celestia and Luna from their youth. She sought to rule ponykind and regarded ordinary ponies as beneath alicorns. According to Spike’s later account, she attacked dragons to become a Fire Alicorn.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 25:1 · the fire alicorn · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Opaline and the preservation of magic, chapter twenty-five, historical account two.

In response to the danger, Twilight sealed pony magic within the Unity Crystals. A protective enchantment kept Equestria hidden from Opaline. Dragon magic was also preserved in the Dragonstone, and dragons entered a long magical slumber.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 25:2 · the protective crystals · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. Opaline and the preservation of magic, chapter twenty-five, historical account three.

By the later age, the three tribes had become divided and no longer had access to their former magic. The precise relationship between the preservation of magic, the division of the tribes and the fates of Twilight and the other princesses is not fully recorded. The former capital and institutions no longer occupy their old place in pony society.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 25:3 · the breaking of the old kingdom · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The lost years and the three new homelands, chapter twenty-six, historical account one.

Earth ponies lived in Maretime Bay, where fear of the other tribes had become common. Argyle Starshine preserved accounts of the ancient friendship of ponykind and passed them on to his daughter Sunny.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 26:1 · maretime bay · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The lost years and the three new homelands, chapter twenty-six, historical account two.

Unicorns inhabited Bridlewood and lived without their former spellcasting. Pegasi dwelt in Zephyr Heights and could no longer fly. Their societies retained distinct customs and developed new technologies.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 26:2 · bridlewood and zephyr heights · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The lost years and the three new homelands, chapter twenty-six, historical account three.

The ancient unity of the tribes survived in stories, artifacts and the knowledge of a few ponies. The precise length of the lost years, and the fates of many older kingdoms and peoples, remain unknown.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 26:3 · the forgotten inheritance · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The restoration of unity, chapter twenty-seven, historical account one.

Sunny Starscout and her friends brought the separated tribes together. The crystals united when the ponies themselves chose friendship, restoring magic and enabling the peoples to share a common future.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 27:1 · the unity crystals · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The restoration of unity, chapter twenty-seven, historical account two.

Pegasi recovered flight and unicorns recovered spells. Earth ponies discovered new plant-growing magic. Sunny manifested an alicorn form through magic. Twilight’s preserved message explains that magic changes and can grow stronger.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 27:2 · the new gifts · history

tracks.announcement_text:
From the Chronicles of Harmony. The restoration of unity, chapter twenty-seven, historical account three.

The later age revealed Together Trees linked by their roots and nourished by the unity of ponies. Opaline exploited the network to steal cutie-mark magic. Ponies gathered in friendship at the trees, while Sparky freed Spike from Opaline’s spell. Their combined efforts defeated her and restored the stolen magic.
tracks.title: the chronicles of harmony · 27:3 · the together trees · history
